name: environment_variables
description: Set the environment variable(s) to auto-fill with this config instance.

name: config_scope
description: Select the directory structure scope which decides the source of environment variables.
info: TerraUtils selects the source for environment variable values based on the chosen scope.
This scope identifier resolves to the value of the corresponding scope of the project directory structure.
Using a 'nil' scope is valid if the same variable needs to be applied regardless of scope.

name: value_config
description: Configure the targets and value sources per chosen config_scope.
info: TerraUtils needs to know which values to target based on the selected config scope (or set a global scope if this is 'nil').
These values must align with the names of the directories in the scope of the project.
For each of these targets, TerraUtils also needs to know where and how to extract the value of the environment variable(s).
This consists of the following configuration options:
- A reference (a file / 1Password path or an explicit string).
- The format of the reference target (e.g. JSON, YAML, TXT, String).
- The key of the environment variable value.
- If the config contains multiple variable values, the subdivisions of the config after the key
(based on the project directory structure, e.g. { client: { env: value } }).
